storage.notes: No built-in eMMC. Records to microSD (not included) or to a eufy HomeBase 3 / HomeBase Mini / HomeBase S1 / NVR S4. HomeBase 3 adds 16GB built-in, expandable to 16TB.

features: Auto-tracking focused light beam with 105 dB siren
180 dual-radar detection up to 40 ft (12 m), 3-zone control
smart welcome lighting (radar + Bluetooth family recognition)
Apple Home (via HomeBase 3), Google Home, Alexa

frigate.notes: RTSP served by the HomeBase, not the camera. Enable in eufy Security app.

home_assistant.notes: No native ONVIF; use the HomeBase RTSP stream as a Generic Camera, or the eufy-security HACS integration (P2P).

blue_iris.notes: Use the HomeBase RTSP URL as a Generic/RTSP source (no ONVIF).
